invariant: If concatenated candidate plaintext matches any W output in that same candidate key, original cipher word must be the singleton corresponding W carrier
gate_inputs: Discovery ciphertext and each candidate's own packages, including inactive W slots; no planted deck, reference model, plaintext truth or held payload
locking: All 48 discovery decisions frozen before truth join and held confirmation
